title: The Sea
author: Gargi Saha
text:
< p>Water, water everywhere
Immeasurable depth as a human mind
Colourless, multifarious
Green, white, blue
Big rise
Small rise

Big fall
Small fall
The sea unravels
As destiny
As the sea changes its course
So does destiny

New hopes wrapped in past despair
Come rolling forth
Like a rainbow of shells
And the glitter of the bangles
What is a man
Before the fathomless, boundless sea.
stanzas: Immeasurable depth as a human mind
As the sea changes its course
New hopes wrapped in past despair
And the glitter of the bangles
